name: The Sunk Cutting
description: A rail cutting the forest has closed over.
arrival: The ground goes down between two banks and the canopy meets overhead, so it is a green tunnel with iron in the floor of it. Roots have come up between the sleepers and lifted them. A signal post stands in the middle with a tree grown through the frame.
notes: The Age of Machinery, reclaimed. This is the thread the map was missing: the line over the strait is not a curiosity, it is the last working piece of something that used to run between two continents. The forest took the rest.
